steps.text: Uptown Lungmen 7:20 P.M.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...You're pretty serious about this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Real unexpected. Never would've thought... that you'd be able to make me bleed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We... have never... been able to walk away... from our past.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, you've always been a part of this city. But... not me. I've always been running.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think I'll ever be able to stand this place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It turned into another one of these in the end.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I can't stop you. Go.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: After I'm gone, please go to the slums for me. The people there are panicked and confused. Someone from the L.G.D. has to protect them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If some Infected kids give you a toy bear...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Keep it. An Ursus girl named Misha taught them how to make those bears. She died, because we failed her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Okay. I will.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm sorry. I owe you one.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't need your apologies. Honestly, you're no good at them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I think we're done here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Go! And don't come back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: 'Can't stand this place?'

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...How many people care about this city as much as you do?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Bullshit...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Inspector Hoshiguma!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...Huh? Inspector, y-you're hurt? Who could have...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Oh, yes, we just saw, err, Madame Ch'en——

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, that, sorry.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do you guys have a second to talk?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Inspector... you're disobeying orders too?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I wouldn't put it that way.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Get out.
Yes, Lord Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I told you... not to call me that.
As you wish. We await your orders.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Miss Kal'tsit and Young Amiya, before you speak, could I have a word with him?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, go ahead, Miss Fumizuki.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All yours.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: We've been together for years now, Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Why talk about this— Why now?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: One look in your eyes and I can tell what you're thinking.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Fumizuki.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Now, now. I've always been able to tell.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I know Lungmen means the world to you. I know all that you've given her. I know about the dreams you have for her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, Fumizuki...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But this, today, this isn't what you want, is it?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Ah, gomen. I'm not referring to our current dilemma.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: What I mean is... this prosperity that you've given everything for.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You lost two loved ones. Actually, I think you said it was three. Maybe dozens?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Surely you couldn't bear to lose your niece as well.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She loathes the Shadow Guard. If I send them to retrieve her, she will fight them to the death.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: No, Wei Yenwu... That's not what I mean.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Won't you regret it? If you let them both die in some foreign city?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: So what if they're Infected? Are they not your nieces?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: If we had children of our own, is this how you would treat them...?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: All that I've done, I've done for the sake of our land. I never intended for Ch'en Hui-chieh to do my work for me.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But that's how she is!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: No. Keeping the truth from her only deepens the cut. It only makes her feel like she doesn't belong here...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Your expectations of her, they're too distant, and too difficult.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But can I stop, at this point?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I have struggled against the men behind me and the city below me for so long, and this is all I have to show for it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Would Lungmen allow me to stop?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That is what she wanted. To get to the source of our problems. She wanted to change this city into something completely unlike the city under my rule.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: All I did was teach her how to get there, what she would have to do, and what she would have to give up.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: All right, that's enough rationalizing. You're giving me a headache.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'll go bring her home myself. I won't sit back and watch her die.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I will do what you cannot.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Nonsense! I won't allow it...!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I have plans to bring her back. And you, Fumizuki, are not to set foot outside this building.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Oh? You'll stop me?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Damare, kono yarou!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whew.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Doctor, what did Miss Fumizuki say?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's been a long time since I've heard such angry Higashinese.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Have you forgotten who I am, Wei Yenwu?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Even I have my limits, Fumizuki.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Have you forgotten who you are?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor, I think...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Mr. Wei might really care for Miss Fumizuki?)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (The same may also go for Fumizuki. Maybe...)

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Now then, on to our friends from Rhodes Island. How much will it cost for you to help Lungmen, and our Ch'en?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'll cover it myself.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're really going to hire us like this, Miss Fumizuki?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: It may be improper to say, but my husband is not exactly in top form today.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Or I might say, our opponent's plans have gone beyond anything we might have predicted, and included all that he holds dear.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: They have a complete understanding of both Lungmen, and Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki, that's enough!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Who are you to say what's enough?!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Doctor, name your price. I can pay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I understand everything you've said here, Miss Fumizuki. And money won't be necessary. But I need you two to hear me out.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe this isn't the place to say it, but if I can speak freely, Lungmen needs some outside assistance.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can I continue, Miss Fumizuki?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: By all means. I don't let words get to me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Nonsense...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island is only a pharmaceutical company.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But the world is a tough place. It doesn't let up on any of us. Especially a pharmaceutical company like ours that tends to make a lot of enemies be it in business, geopolitics, or otherwise.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We wander the cracks between countries because we have no other choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When all the forces of the world align to put pressure on us, we need our own special methods to handle them...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But if our methods are to work— We need the forces acting against us to have a shred of sense left in their thick skulls.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So when there comes a day like today, where anything could happen, Rhodes Island has to be ready with the right response.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Get to the point.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have a proposal.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I hope it's a good one.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not sure if I should be disclosing this information to you, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You must know, with Lungmen's strength and your talents, you could annihilate Rhodes Island with a snap of your fingers.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter how advanced our equipment may be, there is nothing we could do against your forces.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If we act against you, Rhodes Island is as good as dead.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Go on. Dr. Kal'tsit, Miss Amiya, rest assured I have no energy to direct at Rhodes Island anymore.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So please, proceed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When we first met, Mr. Wei, you were very curious about our military capabilities.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can admit now, as I just said, Rhodes Island is no match for Lungmen in this respect.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, no matter how strong a force may be, it can be limited by the circumstances it finds itself in. It's largely a difference of degree.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even your men can't project power with their hands tied. Even if you step onto the battlefield personally, the enemy still has something to use against you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The truth is, a colleague of mine once saw the Duke of Kashchey at a fundraising banquet with his adopted daughter.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This wasn't a slave market or some noble bacchanal. It was an event for those who represent the many movers and shakers of our world.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Continue.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sure you can guess what happened next, Mr. Wei. Many young people proved their value that night, with the ideas and theories that they espoused—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Talulah did not. Neither my colleagues nor I ever expected that she would become the leader of Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In fact... we should have realized that the Duke of Kashchey only shows himself when necessary, to do what is necessary. Otherwise, he stays out of sight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Kashchey won't tip his hand in exchange for assistance, and neither will Talulah. I'm sure you know their relationship much better than we do, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Duke of Kashchey never made her a slave or a hostage.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She is his successor.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Your observations confirm my suspicions, Dr. Kal'tsit. Talulah is Kashchey's successor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Correct. Mr. Wei...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Duke of Kashchey knows what you have, and what you're capable of. Talulah may as well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can leave this in our hands now, Mr. Wei. We have what it takes to handle this situation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Like Amiya told you before, the official agreement between Lungmen and Rhodes Island is over.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: By now, the Rhodes Island landship has left Lungmen's port. What we do from here on has nothing to do with Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is that acceptable, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei. We... won't concern ourselves with the future of Lungmen, or your personal business.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But all this is the result of someone conspiring to exploit the Infected, and we will fight it with all our might.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you'll permit us to act, and if you can promise you won't act against us in any way——

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then the battle to come is our battle, Rhodes Island's battle.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't rely on the Infected. I don't trust the Infected. The only difference between you and Reunion is that you haven't turned against Lungmen... yet.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What was Reunion like before? Even if we don't remember, someone does. They weren't anything like this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You can dress up your schemes in fancy words, just as Reunion can shout from the rooftops that they will be the ones to deliver the Infected from their fate. In the end, they still ended up being cannon fodder for Ursus.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In short order, Ursus will snuff out the fire that is Reunion.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Will you be the next Reunion? Who can say? When will you bare your fangs and turn against us?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What's more, I doubt you have the strength to deal with Kashchey's successor.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That Duke of Kashchey... only Lungmen has successfully opposed him over all these years.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mr. Wei, you intend to personally lead your forces to attack the Chernobog core city, correct?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Don't make blind conjectures.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What you just told me, Mr. Wei, is revealing. You think you're the only one who can handle this situation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's true that Lungmen has the raw power to do it, and you've also overcome the machinations of Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And this time, you intend to sacrifice yourself to nullify the declaration of war on Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As Miss Fumizuki said, you feel you've betrayed your principles, and you hope to end it all with your death.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've made so many mistakes. My death can't pay for them all. I don't even know who I'd be paying.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nevertheless, Mr. Wei, are you so certain that, after your death, no one will bear you any ill will?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen is strategically important to Yan. Thanks to my protection, it will continue to prosper.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I was referring to Lady Fumizuki.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Dr. Kal'tsit... Show some tact!)

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit?! What are you saying?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I meant what I said, Mr. Wei. I'm afraid your wife will suffer because of your actions. Even if you're dead, she is your widow. She'll still know everything you knew.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Since someone is forcing you to act against your will, I believe, this sort of thing... is to be expected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have a feeling that particular individual won't be so magnanimous.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That's enough, Dr. Kal'tsit! You're way out of line. I can't...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You're saying that even if I do this, I still won't be able to protect Fumizuki.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And it may not end with Miss Fumizuki.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...I can go too. Death is the worst that can happen...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Speak, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For the sake of your beloved city... And your beloved people...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am begging you, Lord Wei. Leave this to the experts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We may be powerless against a standing army, but we know the Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We know what they want, and what they don't.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only the Infected can face the Infected.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So, what do you want? Leader of Rhodes Island, Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You're not a charity. Attacking the core city is tantamount to throwing an egg at a boulder. It will be ruinously expensive, and may be utterly futile.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You understand our position, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: At this point, it benefits us both to speak plainly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: More than your agreement with our battle plan, Mr. Wei, we need your guarantee.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Considering you may change your mind in the future... We need your promise, for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because I believe that Lungmen and your family, and Madame Ch'en, are worth that promise.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't need your money, Miss Fumizuki. Your kindness and your attitude toward the Infected are enough for us to execute this operation free of charge.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: (Little rabbit...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: (Gives a thumbs-up)

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I agree. Until the end of the Lungmen-Chernobog conflict, we, Lungmen, will not in any way interfere in Rhodes Island's affairs.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And it looks to me like the good Dr. Kal'tsit has more yet to say.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Speak up. I can endure it, for the time being. Because I need Rhodes Island to save one very specific Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Then, I have another proposal.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Name your price.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Twenty years ago, Edward Artorius, father of Talulah Artorius, died here in Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I would like Mr. Wei to lend us his remains.
